botcomponent.description: Handles missing data, ambiguous requests and compliance guardrails for the Account Recon agent. It returns an Incomplete status with next steps when data is missing, asks clarifying questions, and enforces the no-fabrication and no-send-without-approval rules. Use it when inputs are unclear, when records or fields are missing, or when the user asks to skip approval or override data.
botcomponent.name: ap-recon-error-handling
